snippet.title: Caribbean Legend: Age of Pirates | Announcement Trailer | Pirate Open World RPG  | Sea Dogs
snippet.description:
Caribbean Legend: Age of Pirates — a remaster of Age of Pirates 2: City of Abandoned Ships.

WISHLIST ON STEAM:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3549020/Caribbean_Legend_Age_of_Pirates/

An open-world pirate sandbox where you're the captain and master of your own vessel. In the 17th century Caribbean, there's no better life than this. Serve colonial powers, trade goods, plunder merchant convoys, explore the archipelago, seize cities, hunt for buried treasure, recruit officers, and build a fleet of legendary ships.

Caribbean Legend: Age of Pirates is a unique blend of naval combat, land exploration, and grand strategy. Think Bannerlord or Kenshi, but at sea.
